channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Pro-Palestine attack reduces RAF tanker engines service life
item.description: Damage sustained during a Pro-Palestine attack at RAF Brize Norton has left two RAF Voyager engines with shortened cleared life, forcing the RAF to bring forward major maintenance. The post Pro-Palestine attack reduces RAF tanker engines service life first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Unidentified drones breach Irish airspace on Zelenskyy visit
item.description: Irish security services are examining a significant drone incursion that occurred during the arrival of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin. The post Unidentified drones breach Irish airspace on Zelenskyy visit first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Northrop unveils new ‘Talon’ drone fighter jet
item.description: Northrop Grumman has revealed Project Talon, a new autonomous aircraft designed to operate alongside crewed fighters. The post Northrop unveils new ‘Talon’ drone fighter jet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Over one third of Ajax vehicles caused crew health problems
item.description: More than a third of the Ajax vehicles in a recent British Army training exercise were linked to new noise and vibration injuries, the UK Defence Journal understands. The post Over one third of Ajax vehicles caused crew health problems first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: SACEUR highlights readiness during visit to air command
item.description: Supreme Allied Commander Europe General Alexus Grynkewich visited Allied Air Command headquarters at Ramstein Air Base in November. The post SACEUR highlights readiness during visit to air command first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO sets out how it plans to fight and win at sea
item.description: NATO will further develop carrier strike, anti-submarine, naval mine warfare and seaborne autonomous capabilities to support the ability to deter, defend or decisively strike against an aggressor. The post NATO sets out how it plans to fight and win at sea first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British frigate withdrawn from service in Gulf
item.description: HMS Lancaster will now be retired. The Type 23 Frigate will not return to the UK for decommissioning and will instead be prepared for disposal in Bahrain. The post British frigate withdrawn from service in Gulf first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK considering wider roll out of naval laser weapons
item.description: The UK is weighing whether to arm further Royal Navy ships with DragonFire beyond the initial vessels already funded for integration in 2027. The post UK considering wider roll out of naval laser weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain to take command of major NATO naval force
item.description: The Royal Navy has begun the process of taking command of NATO’s Maritime Allied Reaction Force, the alliance’s primary naval crisis response formation. The post Britain to take command of major NATO naval force first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Neutrality offers no shield as hybrid threats reach Ireland
item.description: CEPA, a leading European security think tank, told the UK Defence Journal that Irish neutrality has no impact on Russian actions against the country or Europe as a whole. The post Neutrality offers no shield as hybrid threats reach Ireland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
